input.new_string:
// Center label — detect dominant currency
  const currency = props.positions.every(p => tickerCurrency(p.ticker) === 'ILS') ? 'ILS'
    : props.positions.every(p => tickerCurrency(p.ticker) === 'USD') ? 'USD' : 'mixed'
  const total = d3.sum(data, (d) => d.value)
  const totalLabel = currency === 'mixed' ? '—' : useCurrency(total, currency)
  g.append('text').attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('dy', '-0.2em')
    .attr('fill', '#94a3b8').attr('font-size', '11')
    .text('Total')
  g.append('text').attr('text-anchor', 'middle').attr('dy', '1em')
    .attr('fill', '#f1f5f9').attr('font-size', '14').attr('font-weight', '600')
    .text(totalLabel)
